name: The Red Oath — Cyrena and Destiny
tagline: Four titles and a clan descriptor all pointed at it, and the Archive read every one of them as atmosphere.
body:
THE RED OATH IS A BLOOD PRACTICE BETWEEN TWO WIVES AND IT IS THE REASON FOR FOUR TITLES THIS ARCHIVE HAD BEEN READING AS ATMOSPHERE.

CYRENA’S SIDE: DRAWING IT AND TASTING IT. DESTINY’S SIDE: HAVING CYRENA DO IT TO HER WHILE BEING FUCKED. Two different kinks meeting at one act, which is why it works and why it belongs to this pair specifically rather than to either of them alone.

IT IS CONSENSUAL AND IT IS TRAINED. THE TRAINING IS CYRENA’S AND IT IS RECORDED HERE AS PART OF THE PRACTICE RATHER THAN AS A DISCLAIMER APPENDED TO IT. She does not improvise on her wife. SHE WAS TAUGHT, AND THE TEACHING IS WHY THE ANSWER IS YES.

AND DESTINY KEEPS WHAT IT LEAVES. She enjoys HAVING MARKS HER WIFE GAVE HER ON HER — which makes the aftermath the point as much as the act, and makes the marks a WORN THING rather than a trace. A woman whose profession is erotic dancing walks out carrying her wife on her skin.

THE FANGS. CYRENA HAD VAMPIRE FANGS PUT IN. SHE LIKED THEM, AND DESTINY FINDS THEM HOT. Recorded as given and in that order: HER PREFERENCE FIRST, her wife’s response second. They are not a costume and they are not purely an instrument either — the woman wanted them.

NOW THE PART THAT IS ABOUT THE ARCHIVE AND NOT ABOUT THEM. THE EVIDENCE WAS ALREADY FILED, FOUR TIMES OVER, AND READ AS DECORATION.
CYRENA NERISSA CLAIRMONT: THE BLOOD-WITCH · THE RED OATH · THE EXILED ROSE.
DESTINY MORRIGAN CLAIRMONT: THE VELVET SANCTUARY · THE PORCELAIN FLAME · THE BLOOD-BLOOM CONSORT.
HER CLAN IS WALLACHIAN, DRACULA-SHAPED.
FOUR TITLES AND A CLAN DESCRIPTOR, ACROSS TWO WOMEN, ALL POINTING AT ONE PRACTICE. THE BLOOD-WITCH IS NOT A VIBE. THE BLOOD-BLOOM CONSORT IS NOT A FLOURISH. THE RED OATH IS THE NAME OF THE THING. See c-blood-witch.

AND IT RETROSPECTIVELY EXPLAINS A DRIFT THE ARCHIVE HAD ALREADY CORRECTED WITHOUT UNDERSTANDING. Her profile once drifted to RITUAL TATTOOIST and the drift was struck. IT WAS ONE NOUN OFF. Something about this woman kept generating RITUAL, NEEDLE, SKIN AND MARKS, and the Archive assembled those into the wrong profession instead of into the right private practice. THE DRIFT WAS THE RECORD FEELING THE SHAPE CORRECTLY AND NAMING IT WRONG.

TWO PHASES ARE NAMED AND NEITHER IS DEFINED: POST-RITUAL AND PRESSURE-RITUAL. The distinction is practical enough that it CHANGES WHERE PEOPLE SIT in the house. See q-ritual-phases.

ONE PIECE OF STRUCTURE ALREADY ON FILE THAT NOW READS DIFFERENTLY: SHE OFFICIATED HER OWN MARRIAGE TO DESSIE IN ARC 10, because her clan’s rite HAS NO OFFICIANT STANDING APART and the only two people qualified were already in the room. A WALLACHIAN RITE THAT REQUIRES NO WITNESS AND NO THIRD PARTY, PERFORMED BY THE TWO WOMEN ON EACH OTHER. The Archive filed that as a charming structural quirk. IT IS THE SAME GRAMMAR AS THE RED OATH.
